Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-21
Author: costa (B3 Phase 2 batch 2)

知乎 has 4 distinct page types that each need a different selector:

  .Post-RichTextContainer  专栏文章（zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/...）
  .RichContent-inner       答案正文（嵌在 .AnswerCard 内部）
  .QuestionRichText        问题描述
  .AnswerCard              答案卡片包装

This fixture exercises an answer-page layout — question above, single
.AnswerCard below. Adding a separate zhihu/column.html for the专栏
form is a Phase 2 batch 3 candidate.

Login-walled 知乎 columns (paid 想法 etc.) are a B1 cookie-injection
concern; the selector path is the same once the page renders, so this
fixture covers the selector contract regardless.
